Our redistricting fight is gaining headlines across Virginia and beyond, and all eyes are on the Commonwealth right now.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260314-331&t=1&akid=331%2E12592%2EByNd8_)
Our redistricting fight is gaining headlines across Virginia and beyond, and all eyes are on the Commonwealth right now. Just take a look at this headline in _The Hill_ :
[](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260314_1.PYj2W9&amount=3&refcode=20260314-331&t=2&akid=331%2E12592%2EByNd8_)
Early voting is underway, and on April 21 Virginians will vote to protect our democracy from blatant partisan power grabs.
The amendment is simple: _it requires voter approval of congressional maps ahead of midterms._ That means politicians can’t redraw districts in the dark. That means Trump and his MAGA allies can’t rig elections in their favor behind closed doors.
But this vote is coming fast. MAGA groups are pouring millions of dollars into Virginia right now to misinform voters and organize support for a NO vote.
Don’t forget a dark money group just sent out mailers trying to compare the redistricting amendment on the ballot to Jim Crow, while using imagery of segregation and the KKK.
What voters hear in the final days could decide everything. That’s why we’re organizing urgently to cut through the noise and:
* **Educate voters** on what the amendment does
* **Counter MAGA misinformation** and deceptive talking points
* **Push back on big dark money spending** meant to tip the scales
* **Reach voters where they are** before April 21 and secure the YES vote

Former President Obama recently endorsed our YES campaign, and warned that Republican-controlled states have redistricted “to give themselves an unfair advantage in the midterms” and that “Virginians can respond.” _We agree._ But responding takes resources, and turnout will decide everything.
[**Every dollar counts****. Will you chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can today to help us reach voters across Virginia in this high-stakes election?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260314_1.PYj2W9&amount=3&refcode=20260314-331&t=3&akid=331%2E12592%2EByNd8_)

Our redistricting fight is gaining headlines across Virginia and beyond, and all eyes are on the Commonwealth right now. Just take a look at this headline in The Hill : Early voting is underway, and on April 21 Virginians will vote to protect our democracy from blatant partisan power grabs. The amendment is simple: it requires voter approval of congressional maps ahead of midterms. That means politicians can’t redraw districts in the dark. That means Trump and his MAGA allies can’t rig elections in their favor behind closed doors. But this vote is coming fast. MAGA groups are pouring millions of dollars into Virginia right now to misinform voters and organize support for a NO vote. Don’t forget a dark money group just sent out mailers trying to compare the redistricting amendment on the ballot to Jim Crow, while using imagery of segregation and the KKK. What voters hear in the final days could decide everything. That’s why we’re organizing urgently to cut through the noise and: Educate voters on what the amendment does Counter MAGA misinformation and deceptive talking points Push back on big dark money spending meant to tip the scales Reach voters where they are before April 21 and secure the YES vote Former President Obama recently endorsed our YES campaign, and warned that Republican-controlled states have redistricted “to give themselves an unfair advantage in the midterms” and that “Virginians can respond.” We agree. But responding takes resources, and turnout will decide everything. Thank you for standing with us, Virginians for Fair Elections

Peter,

March is Women’s History Month — a time to honor the women who changed
this country and the ones still fighting to move it forward.

For generations, women have led the fight for justice, equality, and
opportunity. They fought for the right to vote, stood up for reproductive
freedom, challenged systemic oppression, and built movements that reshaped
our society.

Today, Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida are carrying that legacy in
Congress, refusing to stay silent and pushing our country toward a more
just and equitable future.

They hold billionaires and corporations accountable, fighting for working
families and economic fairness. They champion criminal justice reform and
stand up for communities too often left behind. They fight for immigrant
rights and against systemic oppression wherever it exists. And they lead
the battle for reproductive freedom, housing justice, and against
authoritarianism.

This work wouldn’t be possible without the women who paved the way before
them. Their courage and leadership built the foundation for the progress
we’re making today — and their fight reminds us that there’s still more to
do to ensure equality and opportunity for every woman in every community.

_**EXHIBIT 1 - JOINT FUNDRAISING NOTICE **_

Team Nunn ("JFC") is a joint fundraising committee composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn ("Campaign"), Call to Service PAC ("LPAC") and NRCC (each, a "Committee," and, collectively, the "Committees"). Any contribution to the JFC permissible under the Federal Election Campaign Act, as amended ("FECA"), from contributors who have not exceeded their applicable federal contribution limits, shall be allocated among the Committees pursuant to FECA and the formula set forth in this Notice.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

_**Contributions Made by a Federal Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $120,000. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $10,000, designating up to $5,000 to the primary election and up to $5,000 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3 .NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $15,000 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5 .NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

Contributions to Team Nunn, or to any participating Committee individually, are not deductible as charitable donations for federal income tax purposes. Contributions from corporations, labor organizations, national banks, federal government contractors, foreign nationals without green cards, and other federally impermissible sources are prohibited. The contributor's signature designates his or her contribution to the elections described above. Contributions that exceed a donor's contribution limit to a participating Committee shall be reallocated to the remaining Committees according to this allocation formula to the extent permitted by FECA. Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer of each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in an election cycle or calendar year, as applicable.

body:
[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20260314-61252&t=1001&akid=61252%2E1407376%2EdizTBG ]Demand Justice PAC[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20260314-61252&t=1002&akid=61252%2E1407376%2EdizTBG ]Demand Justice PAC

What was once a narrow process for true emergencies has become a fast
track for Trump’s power grabs.

It’s called the shadow docket.

When Trump wants to circumvent the Constitution or when lower courts block
his illegal actions, his administration runs straight to the Supreme Court
asking for an “emergency” order — no full briefing, no oral arguments, and
often no explanation.

And far too often, the Court’s conservative majority says yes.

Since returning to power, Trump’s administration has filed 33 emergency
applications, and the Court has sided with him about 80% of the time.

These rulings are supposed to be “interim” decisions. But in reality,
they’re anything but and the consequences are clear. Immigrants lose
protections, civil servants are fired, and long-standing limits on
presidential power are quietly weakened — all through decisions issued
with little or no public reasoning.

Demand Justice is fighting back. We’re exposing these abuses and building
pressure for real Supreme Court accountability and reform — but the forces
backing Trump’s judicial overreach are massive.

Peter,

March 14 marks International Pi Day. But if we're talking about numbers, _there are some that just aren't adding up..._

➡️ $1,000 — the extra amount Kentuckians had to spend last year because of Trump's tariffs.
➡️197,000 — the number of Kentuckians who will be kicked off their Medicaid because of Republicans' Big, Ugly bill

➡️ 92,000 — the number of jobs lost across the country last month

body:
#
Peter —
Our movement is about to face our first major test of the general election — the official FEC fundraising deadline on March 31. But before I ask for your support, you deserve an explanation for why this deadline matters at all.
If you already understand and are ready to give, you can use the link below. Otherwise, let me pull back the curtain on these deadlines.
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jt-em-general-launch](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-general-launch.jRB70q&refcode=em260314-1-ak&t=1&akid=501%2E1347274%2EKXojDC)**
On March 31, the Federal Election Commission has an end-of-quarter deadline for every federal campaign. Candidates like me are required to disclose our latest fundraising numbers publicly.
It’s a chance for voters to see how these campaigns are funded. You’ll see a stark contrast between our movement and John Cornyn and Ken Paxton. Our campaign is fueled almost entirely by small donations — not a dime from corporate PACs.
But the truth is that the people paying the most attention will be the media, political pundits, and our opponents and their super PACs.
This deadline, especially since it is our first one of the general election, will be used to size up our campaign’s chances and whether or not there is enough grassroots enthusiasm to take back Texas in November.
If there are any signs of weakness, they’ll use it to say Texas isn’t winnable. Super PACs will see it as a chance to swoop in and drown us out if they think we don’t have the resources to respond. It would be very bad.
A strong report does the opposite. It proves that we have a path to victory with the resources to compete. It fires up even more people to join our effort to take back Texas.
**[So I am sincerely asking you to please contribute $5 ahead of our first FEC deadline of the general election. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: When I came out
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=5261%2E35263%2EEaMWgb ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Peter, can I
tell you a story?

When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public
service, but I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between
pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-mar26.vzQga2&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260314_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=5261%2E35263%2EEaMWgb ][IMG]

Seeing other women in the LGBTQ community demonstrate acts of courage by
coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who
they love — I came to realize that I could do both. I could run for office
and be honest about who I am. And that’s exactly what I did.

When I was elected, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary
opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. And from lowering
prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the
Respect for Marriage Act, I’ve worked hard every day since to do just
that.

That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but
to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted
to make a difference, too. Now, as we celebrate together the lives and
contributions of women everywhere, I'm asking you again:

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/4853?c0=stb-em-mar26.vGNQaR&t=1005&akid=5261%2E35263%2EEaMWgb ]Will you help me continue to make a difference by pitching in to help
me keep up the fight?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/4858?c0=stb-em-mar26.PIYO5E&t=1010&akid=5261%2E35263%2EEaMWgb ]CHIP IN $100 NOW

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/4859?c0=stb-em-mar26.pH5xeV&t=1011&akid=5261%2E35263%2EEaMWgb ]ANOTHER AMOUNT

Over the years, we have made incredible progress in the fight for
equality.
But Peter,
we cannot mistake that progress for a total victory.

Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass
harmful legislation, attacking reproductive access and rolling back
women’s rights, including for LGBTQ women.

It’s going to take all of us this Women’s History Month and every other
month to counter these right wing attacks so everyone — even a kid like me
— grows up knowing they belong, and that kindness and inclusion, not
hatred and division, are American values.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/4888?t=1012&akid=5261%2E35263%2EEaMWgb ]This Women’s History Month, I am making a promise I’ll keep up the
fight as long as I can, and I’m hoping you’ll support our important work
by chipping in to help us advocate for human rights for everyone.

Democrats are so sure of themselves that keeping certain parts of the Department of Homeland Security defunded in order to handcuff ICE is a winning strategy. In just a short amount of time, it has proven to be anything but.
While longer lines through TSA at airports is certainly a hassle and an inconvenience, due to short staffing since TSA agents are not getting paid, the terrorist attacks that have occurred in recent weeks are even more worrisome.
In a few weeks, the following has taken place:
* An improvised explosive device was thrown at anti-Islamic protesters in New York City.
* A naturalized citizen shot up a bar in Austin in apparent revenge for the U.S. military strikes in Iran.
* A terrorist sympathizer shot and killed an ROTC instructor while shouting "Allahu Ackbar" at Old Dominion in Norfolk. The suspect was also a naturalized citizen.
* A man drove his car into Jewish synagogue while shooting. He was killed before taking any lives by private security.

This is what the nation is facing while Democrats once again play fast and loose with national security because they are upset immigration laws are being enforced. Not only are they willing to shield illegal aliens, even if they have criminal histories, but they are willing to put American lives in even more danger.
Say what you will about the strikes in Iran, but the ongoing operations are an even greater reason to make sure the homeland is secure. How the Left can justify such political theatre is beyond me, but it is not surprising. Remember they did nothing to reign in the Biden-Harris administration's border crisis when the polls were still in their favor.
It was not until the 2024 election and polling showing they were underwater did they feign an attempt to solve the issue, which was to propose an "immigration reform" bill that would have codified the worst aspects of the border crisis, such as funding the NGOs who were facilitating the crisis.

* You're reported to the state.

**My Alliance Defending Freedom client, Born Again Used Books, out of Colorado Springs, Colorado, faces this very risk every day that it opens its doors.** ****

We have a massive update from the trail.
A new poll released this week shows Mallory tied for first place.
But here is the most important part: Mallory is tied for the lead despite having _10 points less name recognition than her opponents._
Even with a fraction of the name ID, Mallory’s message is resonating so deeply that she has surged to the top of the field.
_This is what momentum looks like._
The poll also confirmed what we already knew: Mallory has the highest net favorability of any candidate in the race. Voters like her, they trust her, and they want her to lead — they just need to meet her.
Our opponents have spent years building their brands, but Mallory is already catching them. The path here is simple: if we can close that 10-point name ID gap, we win this thing. We just need the resources to get Mallory’s message out to every voter.

clean_body: Jane’s work is too important to ignore. | = Hi there, it's Lily Tomlin. Jane Fonda is one of the most tenacious human beings I have ever known. Trust me, fifty years of friendship tells you a whole lot about a person. So when I say that the work Jane is doing right now with her Climate PAC matters — in a this-is-not-a-drill kind of way — I mean it. I’ve watched her fight for decades even if that fight sometimes ended with us in handcuffs. = Here's the truth: What’s happening in our country isn’t normal, and we can’t let ourselves forget that. An illegal war launched without congressional approval. A government that has decided corporate polluters matter more than the people breathing their poison. Democratic norms being dismantled faster than most people can track. Business as usual is behind us. And what comes next is shaped by the people who refuse to go along with it. Jane refuses. Her Climate PAC is doing the unglamorous, essential work of electing brave leaders from public utility boards to Congress who refuse right along with her — people who will fight for our planet, our democracy, and our fundamental freedoms every single time. What many people don’t realize is that these fights are won long before Election Day. Friend, I am officially running for re-election in Michigan’s 12th congressional district. **This week, we filed our petition to be on the ballot, submitting the maximum-allowed 2,000 signatures, with people signing from every city and township in the district.** This is what a people-powered campaign looks like: one that meets residents where they are and responds to their needs. In my time in Congress, I’ve introduced and passed legislation that invests in clean water, stopped water shutoffs, and invests directly in our communities, including in senior and community centers. **In my district alone, we’ve invested $52 million:** ✔ $23.6 Million for Community Spaces _(parks, schools, health centers, green spaces, and more)_ ✔ $12.3 Million for Water Projects _(lead pipe replacement, water lines/systems, pumps)_ ✔ $6.6 Million for Housing _(affordable, home repairs, shelters)_ ✔ $5.5 Million for Economic Development _(training, workforce, broadband, and more)_ ✔ $2 **I am running for re-election because our work together in Congress is far from done.**
We’re demanding justice from Detroit to Gaza. We’re demanding ICE out of our communities and an end to forced family separation. We’re demanding an economy that puts everyday people first, not billionaires and greedy corporations. **And, instead of more blank checks for war and military aggression, we’re demanding investments in our communities here at home.**
I need your support, not just to power our movement to stand up to Trump, but to prepare for the re-election fight ahead.
**We saw what happened in the 2024 election when right-wing AIPAC millionaires flooded Democratic primaries, defeating two of our progressive allies.** That’s why we’re preparing now for our re-election, because we need voices in Congress who are willing to take on the billionaire bullies, corporate greed, and the pro-genocide lobby.

clean_body: I need your support, not just to power our movement to stand up to Trump, but to prepare for the re-election fight ahead. | | | Friend, I am officially running for re-election in Michigan’s 12th congressional district. This week, we filed our petition to be on the ballot, submitting the maximum-allowed 2,000 signatures, with people signing from every city and township in the district. This is what a people-powered campaign looks like: one that meets residents where they are and responds to their needs. In my time in Congress, I’ve introduced and passed legislation that invests in clean water, stopped water shutoffs, and invests directly in our communities, including in senior and community centers. In my district alone, we’ve invested $52 million: ✔ $23.6 Million for Community Spaces (parks, schools, health centers, green spaces, and more) ✔ $12.3 Million for Water Projects (lead pipe replacement, water lines/systems, pumps) ✔ $6.6 Million for Housing (affordable, home repairs, shelters) ✔ $5.5 Million for Economic Development (training, workforce, broadband, and more) ✔ $2 Million for Roads ✔ $1.5 Million for Public Services (fire department and equipment) | I am running for re-election because our work together in Congress is far from done. We’re demanding justice from Detroit to Gaza. We’re demanding ICE out of our communities and an end to forced family separation. We’re demanding an economy that puts everyday people first, not billionaires and greedy corporations. And, instead of more blank checks for war and military aggression, we’re demanding investments in our communities here at home. I need your support, not just to power our movement to stand up to Trump, but to prepare for the re-election fight ahead. We saw what happened in the 2024 election when right-wing AIPAC millionaires flooded Democratic primaries, defeating two of our progressive allies. That’s why we’re preparing now for our re-election, because we need voices in Congress who are willing to take on the billionaire bullies, corporate greed, and the pro-genocide lobby. I believe in something pretty simple: If you work hard and play by the rules, the American Dream should be yours.
**The thing is, people are working hard and playing by the rules, but life is too expensive, and hardworking people are struggling to get their slice of the American Dream.**

[**If you’re with me, double down right now on support for the America First agenda.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d6e19412dfa54da7abaa2eb75f00fcfc&_e=dHM6bUZ3gBe_hthsReakeJNEn90QvVKL_LuIuNqLSQqE_t7J_opWQ7q8VZRcY1N_eGlbQ5afNh86-HDOEO8SI99t4U6oaXKPHTSgHLz4mBUJyvDh-46qyIY62QnFksy_MTYR-HOglYi-eHnMrI6g1luB2bGiDticpR3lXrZmgko2Dm8NbpmuLmvYr9diHvIqKE6facKIjg_Hc-Zsuos1--dWaeXTU8JyuuGRou9S_Dxt1t8h1x_56JOBoz0hO9HVaPnUCrr2SVNhZvmEJqL6Z-_5NLalLP099ukYygIcrgQddSLMGFEiKR-rOzgBRGK9KC2Nu4IzQg4dS1UNx-gFaa6c2hrXRQlLrcy9pJw8GndiONePucpYMfds1H17-5bpTqys6a6-Br2IsHA82nq6pM5OjJoiEBq-1BFjqKopv5yCEKh1hymT-oojFaJXZ08hfBvEpx3Fotgb9U7SqFyhYGq78tYuXJPSPAKgY_ktX1mpAy3cvb1aLWWS0vFi3B_9Aqj_5Ih2OWwu42LO88-162rr6BvGz7F0_ZWH6ruaUK-xgPLAapdZeOQNJopMw79mBD5CesemgLmEfFNyGPy54GBBxRHkP0zs-MaNPukc56wuK4_h9wc-ePgX1ie3Rpx1je7C_D9xo8GhEotB7SwWJjnZEbV46R0uF1f98hWgYyjvTcxJK2zYMLCHn4s9D2iC)

When Governor DeSantis appointed me to replace Marco Rubio, I knew that this wasn’t going to be easy. I knew that the Radical Left was going to throw everything they’ve got at me. Peter, **In January, former CNN anchor Don Lemon and independent journalist Georgia Fort were arrested for covering anti-ICE protests in Minneapolis.** The pair were livestreaming and reporting on a group of activists’ interruption of services at a church where an ICE official presides as pastor. In short, they were doing their jobs as journalists. **In an unprecedented move, Trump’s Department of Justice arrested them both.** The Department of Justice claims Lemon and Fort were intimidating the pastor. But the entire exchange was caught on film, and it’s clear that the journalists weren’t breaking the law—their actions were entirely legal under the First Amendment. **Once again, the MAGA Supreme Court’s decision putting Trump above the law is rearing its ugly head.** Arresting journalists is exactly the type of oppressive, unconstitutional action only an authoritarian administration who’s been given impunity from breaking the law would take. [**Arresting journalists for doing their job is the first step to tearing down our First Amendment rights entirely. The Attorney General needs to hear the American people demanding the Justice Department drop all charges against Georgia Fort and Don Lemon. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | First Invеstmеnt Updаtеs brоught tо уоu bу Іnception Media, LLC. name: David Hogg
subject: The media loves to drag this one out
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
This is about building a coalition of leaders of any age who will fight for working people.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260314-1&t=1&akid=3248%2E587540%2EJi8HEB)
Peter,
I want to clear something up: **I don’t hate old people.**
The media loves framing our fight as young vs. old, but that’s not the truth. The real issue isn’t about age, it’s about incumbent Democrats who have gotten too comfortable in their seats and abandoned the people they were elected to serve.
It’s about leaders who lack the integrity, courage, and forethought to know when it’s time to pass the torch.
And listen, there _are_ older leaders who are solid on progressive issues and have truly pushed the Democratic Party forward. Leaders like Ed Markey who helped author the Green New Deal and inspire young climate activists across the country, and Bernie Sanders who has spent decades fighting for universal healthcare and now is directly uplifting young candidates across the country.
What’s really at the core of this fight is pushing back against leaders of _any_ age who prioritize corporate interests over working people. Too many Democrats spend their time in office clinging to their seats by playing it safe instead of delivering on all the promises they made while trying to win that seat.
There are plenty of older folks who see that problem, too.
Just look at what President Obama said in an interview a few weeks ago:
> _“I’m not making a hard and fast rule here, but I do think that Democrats do well when we have candidates who are plugged into the moment, to the zeitgeist, to the times and the particular struggles that folks are thinking about as they look towards the future, rather than look backward toward the past.”
_
This is not an issue of age nearly as much as it is one of competency and integrity.
Unfortunately, there are corrupt and incompetent people of all ages who belong nowhere near the halls of power. What we are doing at Leaders We Deserve is finding the right young people to lead this moment with energy and integrity.
And we’re focused on building an intergenerational coalition of leaders working together to push our Party forward, and make sure our government answers to us, not corporations or billionaires.
**[If you’re with me, can you pitch in $5 today to help us elect progressive leaders who will stand up to corporate greed and fight for working families?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260314_1_old.LLJ5EX&refcode=em20260314-3248&amount=5&t=2&akid=3248%2E587540%2EJi8HEB)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

name: Mark Kelly
subject: This wasn't the plan
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense
#

Friends, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life.
But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense, or to have the President of the United States calling for my execution.
Look, I don’t want you to worry about me. I’ve been through a lot in my life, and things like this don’t intimidate me all that much.
I do worry that Trump might succeed at intimidating others, though. Like people just beginning to get involved, or thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a town hall. I worry Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him.
But then I look at this team. You’ve been with me for a long time, and you haven’t backed down. That means so much to me, and gives me a lot of hope.
I am ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. If you’re with me, please:

That means so much to me, and gives me a lot of hope. I am ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. # An Update from the S.C. Senate

The General Assembly returned to Columbia on January 13 to begin the 2026 legislative session, and we continue to work through meaningful legislation designed to uphold South Carolina’s values, protect public safety, and ensure our state remains a strong place to live, work, and raise a family.
**Cutting Taxes on Boats** _**Status: Passed the SC Senate**_
_**Status: Sent back to the House with amendments**_

This legislation ([H.3858](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=1b46b16268&e=3115da0ee7)) simplifies how boats and outboard motors are taxed in South Carolina. Currently, boats and their motors are titled and taxed separately, often resulting in confusing paperwork and higher costs for boat owners.
H.3858 creates a single tax for both the boat and motor, lowers the overall tax rate, and eliminates the need for separate titles and tax bills. This change will make the system easier for taxpayers and help encourage boat owners to register their vessels in South Carolina rather than in other states.
The Senate passed the bill with amendments, and it will now return to the House for final approval.

**Drug Induced Homicide** _**Status: Passed the SC Senate**_ This legislation ([S.183](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=f48641197c&e=3115da0ee7)) creates a new felony offense for drug-induced homicide in South Carolina. Under the bill, individuals who knowingly sell or distribute controlled substances that directly lead to someone’s death could be held criminally responsible.
Those convicted could face significant prison time, with penalties of up to 30 years. The measure is intended to strengthen accountability for drug dealers whose actions contribute to fatal overdoses.

**DOT Modernization** _**Status: Passed the SC Senate**_
This legislation ([S.831](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=f633ef34bf&e=3115da0ee7)) modernizes how South Carolina plans and delivers transportation projects. It creates a Coordinating Council for Transportation and Mobility to improve coordination and help move projects forward more efficiently.
The bill also expands the Department of Transportation’s authority to use new project delivery methods and public-private partnerships, while strengthening oversight and updating provisions related to local transportation planning.

**College Campus Event Zoning**
_**Status: Passed the SC Senate**_

This legislation ([S.832](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=6422821122&e=3115da0ee7)), which I co-sponsored, ensures that state-supported colleges and universities can host events on their campuses without being blocked by local zoning restrictions. If an event is approved by the institution’s governing board, local governments would not be able to prohibit it based solely on zoning or land use rules.
At the same time, the bill makes clear that local authorities can still enforce standard safety requirements, including building codes, fire safety, health regulations, and traffic management. The goal is to give universities greater certainty when planning campus events while maintaining important public safety protections.

**Nitrous Oxide Restrictions for Minors**
_**Status: Passed the SC Senate**_ There is a growing misuse of nitrous oxide products by minors. The bill ([S.751](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=fcaed54f5c&e=3115da0ee7)) makes it illegal to sell or provide nitrous oxide to anyone under the age of eighteen and bans flavored nitrous oxide products that are often marketed to younger users.
At the same time, the legislation preserves lawful uses of nitrous oxide by establishing clear exceptions for legitimate medical, commercial, and industrial purposes.

**Faculty Licensing for Dental and Veterinary Schools**
_**Status: Passed the SC Senate**_ This legislation ([H.4342](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=b8b196a7f0&e=3115da0ee7)) helps South Carolina’s dental and veterinary schools recruit and retain qualified faculty. The bill allows certain full-time dental school instructors to receive a restricted teaching license without meeting additional education requirements, provided they are serving in accredited programs.
It also creates a similar pathway for veterinary school faculty, allowing the state’s veterinary board to issue restricted licenses so instructors can teach and practice within the academic setting.

_**Bills Signed Into Law**_
**Extend Alcohol Server Training Deadline**
A joint resolution to extend the deadline for servers to receive alcohol server training as required by law to May 1, 2026.

**Homicide by Child Abuse**
This legislation ([S.405](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=a17ced9802&e=3115da0ee7)) strengthens South Carolina’s homicide by child abuse law by expanding its protections to include all minors under the age of eighteen. Current law only applies when the victim is under eleven years old. The bill ensures those responsible for the death of a minor through abuse or neglect can be fully held accountable under the law.

**Telehealth Veterinary Services**
This legislation ([H.3223)](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=650a646db0&e=3115da0ee7) allows licensed veterinarians in South Carolina to provide certain services through telemedicine. Prescriptions may only be issued after a veterinarian has established a relationship with the animal through a prior in-person exam or visit, ensuring the same standard of care as traditional treatment.

* * *
* * *
Something I've often thought about these past few years mulling over the profound and unquantifiable, the virtues of the human existence, "the marrow of life" as Whitman called it, mystery of being, in a silent fence line walk through my farm, admittedly sometimes even during a less-than focused morning Rosary... it hit me again today while on the tractor bushhogging a field to receive some several dozen ewes and their newborn lambs.
Jill Biden is the most evil woman of the 21st century.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aa2e3b54-ef35-44d4-acc8-3fa419253082?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Not "person" because there are plenty of men who outshine her by order of magnitudes on the scale of evil. Feminists, don't even bother to email me your outrage, for just like in sports, men outshine women in evil. Rejoice, ladies: the loss is actually your victory for this is not a trophy to display. But many 21st century men are more evil than Jill: the recently unalived Ayatollah. Hugo Chavez. Doctor Fauci.
But in the female division, the winner of most evil in the 21st century goes to Jill.
"Why?", you ask? Because of what she did to us viz-a-vis her _non compos mentis_ husband.
Joe is Mentally incapacitated. Jill capitalized on it.
The marriage vow to love, honor, and cherish is exhaustive. It is why so many marriages fail as it requires to deepest of self-denial and sacrifice. There is not greater moment of love, honor, and cherish as when the other is incapable of doing it themself. On the smallest scale it is not letting your spouse take a photo with broccoli in his teeth. On a larger scale it is not letting your incapacitated spouse have the nuclear codes.
I will not allow you to be ridiculed or defiles. Because I love, honor, and cherish you.
Cherish means no one, literally no one, not even the children, no one will look out for you, my spouse, as much as I will. And if you are too incapacitated to make a decision like "how do I walk off the stage?" then I will try to take those decisions away from you. I will not give you more, larger, graver decisions because I cherish you.
Jill Biden is evil, the most evil woman of the 21st century, not just because of what she did to Joe, but because of what she did to us, too. Bad enough you let a drunk have the car keys but now do so with the neighbors' kids in the back. It's a miracle we survived, yes, but I don't want to live on luck. "Phew! Dodged that one!" is not my style in the passenger seat.
I have great loathing of Joe Biden having followed him as a haughty, lying, racist, phony S.O.B. my entire life. He entered the Senate before I was even born, and I'm 51, so politically I've grown up with the prick. But I will always have the slightest, slightest bit of sympathy for him these past few years as I know he is not there. Call it Catholic guilt (as I call him a prick...)
Diminished mental capacity is tragic and something I fear for myself. Dad had it. He only confided in my sister about the full state of his mental decline. He didn't tell my mom, his wife of 55 years. He didn't tell his sons, but we knew. It was obvious. At moments he was "off". Ask him about the Yankees / Dodgers World Series matchups of his childhood and he could name every player and their post season record. Ask him if he ate lunch, and he'd say, "I don't know".
Despite 40+ years working on Wall Street, we didn't ask dad to go be the CEO of brokerage firm. He could not have done it. It would have been cruel to him, the staff, the shareholders... Thank God my mother is not the type to scheme. "I can become super rich..."
Jill Biden used her husband's depleted mental state for gain. She got to be First Lady. Her friends got positions, appointments, contracts. She got a [$60 million](https://substack.com/redirect/2195eb54-9934-4f0d-a793-ea667c6d7d83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) book deal. Her granddaughter got a White House wedding. She got to decorate, entertain, dress, parade, attend, and all with the dutiful adoration of the liberal media.
Those Indian scammers who call gullible elderly pretending to be the IRS and demanding payment are Mother Theresa compared to Jill.
I've written and talked to much about Biden's legacy from energy to foreign policy to national security, open borders, lifting Iranian sanctions, crime, trans insanity, his deviant scumbag son and his finger doodles selling for $500k to anonymous buyers. The state he left in which he put our nation. The filth. The weakness. The wokeness. The depravity. The deeply unAmerican, unpatriotic, unChristian, inhumane scumbaggery of Biden. I written and talked too much about it to repeat it here. It hurts to revisit.
But it was all Jill. Jill who allowed it. Jill who knew the forces of evil wanted her to break that vow to love, honor, and cherish Joe, and she did. Judas' was cheap. 30 pieces of silver is nothing compared to being American Regent. And in betraying those vows, betraying Joe, she made us all weaker, poorer, sicker, worse off as a nation.
Death is more honorable than what Jill did to her husband and to America.
Lucky for her, the century is barely 1⁄4 finishes, so there's plenty of time and opportunity for another to surpass her. One is already trying for the title: the muslim wife of NYC's muslim Mayor Zohan Mamdami "**[liked](https://substack.com/redirect/6d8949bd-a1d7-4d5e-afc1-f296b6f4cda7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** " a Facebook post celebrating the mass rape of Israeli women on the October 7th massacre, so if you're following, she's one to keep an eye on.
History will not be kind to Jill scoring her somewhere between the real Catherine de Medici and the fictional Lady MacBeth. But something else will not be kind to Jill and that is God's judgment. I hope she repents before facing it. Call it Catholic guilt (as I call him a prick and her a...).
Dad died before he got too bad. I often consider it a small mercy that God saved me from having to watch him decline further. God save us from those who seek riches and power and fortune at our expense. And God give us the strength to fight them with every breath in our body.
Strength and Honor.
**Honor and Courage.**

|
Peter,
Right now, it feels like we are living inside a timeline similar to a dystopian science fiction novel.
A president floating a third term. Neighbors dragged from their homes by federal agents. Americans gunned down in the streets by ICE. A.I. driven warfare with autonomous drones and missiles in Iran.
But it gets worse. Trump is systematically working to rig elections to lock in his power permanently: the Save Act, gerrymandering schemes, and open threats against political opponents.
That is exactly why Defend Our Court exists, we saw the architecture Trump was building. State Supreme Courts under a full-on assault by his administration--the same courts who would have final say on how elections are administered in their respective states.
So we got to work.
In 2025, we planted our flag in Pennslyvania and fought to keep MAGA from seizing the Supreme Court of the most important swing state in America. We won and dealt a significant setback to MAGA's election rigging scheme. Now, we're moving onto Wisconsin. And the consequences of this election could ripple forward for a generation:

---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001uum9QzRFnkA7012xgwm_byqdiP0ZBr2KMEmWMpMlEE84EuZ7ZCpL7vxmPJMwouVAHAmJkUyCBKmUwceIZ5_MKNDbG1v-bNqzoEYOJEhxJT8naykE3ion1ZOBvH28jpG0uc_A70VSXKjwdTLK_s4TrWmwmmhePFkx7i_3CMww1L4y5HOJDemPPoLA4NEzzpJP38XISa6wExWqrYL6oFjBzfe2Em8yHPLAT3J4YMV9OSc=&c=IAP3QjwC-DnCvv9XtHsHEYPPyQ_J0BQUXo_5s4wCKxWid6AQxIWqcA==&ch=xpv2UtgIk_nq5gYFtKrBLhRzEhRa51cT54V63WqQCKULgvCFFrRlxw==)
---

The Wisconsin Supreme Court sits at a 4-3 liberal majority right now, a margin Democrats built by embarrassing Elon Musk last year. On April 7, another seat is open.
If we win in April, that majority jumps to 5-2. Combined with last year's win, we are looking at a guaranteed Democratic majority on that court straight through 2030.
MAGA cannot touch it. Not during Trump's presidency.
But if we lose, it opens the possibility for MAGA to flip the court just months before the 2028 presidential election. If the presidency comes down to a handful of swing states like it always does and MAGA controls the court, Wisconsin becomes a weapon pointed straight at democracy.
Trump's heir, or Trump himself, with a court ready to block votes, redraw maps, and bury challenges. The door closes. Maybe for good.
The butterfly effect.
This is chaos theory in action: one small intervention, at the right moment, in the right place, sends ripples that reshape everything downstream. We proved it in Pennsylvania. Now we apply it in Wisconsin.
Because fighting fascism cannot just be resistance. Resistance is reactive. It means you are always a step behind, always answering their last move. The only way to beat fascism is to already be there when they arrive, by being one step ahead.
[We have just 27 days to defend Wisconsin's Supreme Court. clean_body: | | | | | == | Peter, Right now, it feels like we are living inside a timeline similar to a dystopian science fiction novel. A president floating a third term. Neighbors dragged from their homes by federal agents. Americans gunned down in the streets by ICE. A.I. driven warfare with autonomous drones and missiles in Iran. But it gets worse. Trump is systematically working to rig elections to lock in his power permanently: the Save Act, gerrymandering schemes, and open threats against political opponents. That is exactly why Defend Our Court exists, we saw the architecture Trump was building. State Supreme Courts under a full-on assault by his administration--the same courts who would have final say on how elections are administered in their respective states. So we got to work. In 2025, we planted our flag in Pennslyvania and fought to keep MAGA from seizing the Supreme Court of the most important swing state in America. We won and dealt a significant setback to MAGA's election rigging scheme. Now, we're moving onto Wisconsin. And the consequences of this election could ripple forward for a generation: | == The Wisconsin Supreme Court sits at a 4-3 liberal majority right now, a margin Democrats built by embarrassing Elon Musk last year. On April 7, another seat is open. If we win in April, that majority jumps to 5-2. Combined with last year's win, we are looking at a guaranteed Democratic majority on that court straight through 2030. MAGA cannot touch it. Not during Trump's presidency. But if we lose, it opens the possibility for MAGA to flip the court just months before the 2028 presidential election. If the presidency comes down to a handful of swing states like it always does and MAGA controls the court, Wisconsin becomes a weapon pointed straight at democracy. Trump's heir, or Trump himself, with a court ready to block votes, redraw maps, and bury challenges. The door closes. Maybe for good. The butterfly effect. This is chaos theory in action: one small intervention, at the right moment, in the right place, sends ripples that reshape everything downstream. We proved it in Pennsylvania. Now we apply it in Wisconsin. Because fighting fascism cannot just be resistance. Resistance is reactive. It means you are always a step behind, always answering their last move. Voter Action Project[https://voteractionproject.org/]
After the House recently passed the SAVE America Act (the new version of the SAVE Act), the Senate is all we have left to stop this suppressive legislation from becoming law ahead of the midterm elections , folks.
Defenders of voting rights know that non-citizen voting is already illegal, extremely rare, and that this bill is written in a way that could disenfranchise millions of eligible women across the country. That's not stopping Trump from social media tantrums, however:
Trump Truth Social post refusing to sign any other bills before the SAVE America Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031426_1&amount=35]
Opponents of voting rights in Congress -- and in the White House -- favor this new SAVE America Act because they know it could suppress millions of eligible voters, changing the composition of the electorate and potentially empowering them and their party for years to come.
Please, Team, support our efforts to hold the Senate accountable and stop this dangerous legislation with $35 or whatever you can and ensure millions of women's voices continue to be heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031426_1&amount=35]

We know the SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before November, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
The consequences of a bill like this passing would be simply catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031426_1&amount=35]

Team, History has a few lessons Donald Trump seems determined to ignore. **First:** when presidents rush the country toward conflict without a clear strategy, Americans pay the price. **Second:** when government agents start acting like the rules don’t apply to them, it erodes the rule of law. **Third:** when leaders surround themselves with people who won’t challenge them, bad decisions spiral. And right now, that’s exactly what we’re seeing. Trump is surrounded by mouthpieces like Karoline Leavitt, Pete Hegseth, and Marco Rubio, people whose job is defending his decisions instead of asking the questions the country deserves answered. Meanwhile, Republicans in Congress just voted down the War Powers Resolution that would force a debate before sending Americans into another conflict. These problems come from the same place: leaders who think power shouldn’t have limits. Seth got into politics because he saw the consequences of leadership failures in Washington while he was in the Marines. Now Republicans in Congress are so afraid of Donald Trump that they are scared to object to a war that the American people do not want. First: when presidents rush the country toward conflict without a clear strategy, Americans pay the price. Second: when government agents start acting like the rules don’t apply to them, it erodes the rule of law. Third: when leaders surround themselves with people who won’t challenge them, bad decisions spiral. And right now, that’s exactly what we’re seeing. Trump is surrounded by mouthpieces like Karoline Leavitt, Pete Hegseth, and Marco Rubio, people whose job is defending his decisions instead of asking the questions the country deserves answered. Meanwhile, Republicans in Congress just voted down the War Powers Resolution that would force a debate before sending Americans into another conflict. These problems come from the same place: leaders who think power shouldn’t have limits. Seth got into politics because he saw the consequences of leadership failures in Washington while he was in the Marines. Now Republicans in Congress are so afraid of Donald Trump that they are scared to object to a war that the American people do not want. # [🐾 WOOF! Pip here with a paws-itively important update](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=190864789&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkwODY0Nzg5LCJpYXQiOjE3NzM1MTUwNDcsImV4cCI6MTc3NjEwNzA0NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.N7fnJXofoC864OProYgyAWBtv99Qw0EX3B4731S5RZE)
### Zoomies, snacks, and a special message from Team Haley's (unofficial) campaign dog
Mar 14
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..zKr9GEezyN4uumJcj8KBtJsNSL29e8AyVunnt2onSLE?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/woof-pip-here-with-a-paws-itively?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Hi best friend!!! 🐶💖
**WOOF WOOF!! It 's me, Pip!**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/60024adc-df62-4251-aaa0-283b2b5518b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**I 'm the unofficial Haley Stevens for Senate campaign dog**, official good boy, part-time squeaky toy collector, full-time snack taster, and proud emotional support for the entire Team Haley pack!!! 🐾💙 I'm best friends with Bailey, the *official* campaign dog. It's ruff work on the campaign trail, so I'm happy to lend a paw when I can.
If we haven't met yet, hiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!!! I love you! I'm so excited you're here!! My whole body is wiggling. I may knock something over. 😇
**A little about me ...**
🦴 I love treats
😴 I love naps
💙 I love Michigan
🐾 I love my mom's friend, Haley Stevens
I've been spending a LOT of time around the campaign lately, and let me tell you something: The humans are BUSY. Like, capital B Busy.
There are meetings, laptops, spreadsheets, and so many people saying things like "mid-month pacing" and "daily goal" and "fundraising projections," and honestly?? It all sounds exhausting. 🥴💻
Meanwhile, I'm over here doing the really important work of looking adorable and occasionally losing my mind because someone is eating a Coney dog within 100 feet of my nose. 🌭🚨
But even though I am sometimes distracted by hot dogs, I can tell something big is happening.
Because when the humans start typing faster, talking louder, and drinking coffee like crazy ☕ ... it means campaign stuff is getting real.
And right now?
**The humans are focused on reaching a $200,000 mid-month goal.**
Which I guess is important because it helps give Team Haley the resources to keep this campaign going strong - and ideally, leads to more snacks for ya boy, Pip. 🐾
But really, it's all because these humans LOVE Michigan. Haley talks about it basically all the time. She's honestly a little obsessed...
But I get it - Haley grew up here, helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs during the auto rescue, and has been fighting for Michiganders every day in Congress.
**Haley is, in my professional opinion, the kind of human Michiganders want leading the pack.** 🫡🐶
From where I'm sitting - usually next to Bailey or under my mom's desk - this campaign is full of people who care a LOT.
They care about Michigan. They care about the people they're fighting for. And, importantly, they care about making sure I get pets.
Which I do. 🐶✨
I just wanted to pop in and say hi!! And before I eat a tasty snack, I want to ask:
**[If you'd like to help Team Haley reach its $200,000 mid-month goal, I think that would be paws-itively amazing. ](https://substack.com/redirect/e74bf22b-f193-4fb4-aa34-7b975171b57e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[🐾💸](https://substack.com/redirect/e74bf22b-f193-4fb4-aa34-7b975171b57e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
No pressure!!! I'm literally a dog!! I have zero dollars to my name. But if you're able to chip in a few bucks, I know that Haley and the humans here would be very grateful.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/e74bf22b-f193-4fb4-aa34-7b975171b57e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OK, gotta go now!!! Bailey and I need to patrol for fallen snacks 🚨 so I can be rested and ready before my afternoon zoomie appointment. Biiii!
XOXO and 700 tail wags,
Pip 🐶
(Unofficial) Team Haley campaign dog
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/e74bf22b-f193-4fb4-aa34-7b975171b57e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
###### Paid for by Haley Stevens for Michigan.

Fellow Conservative,

I know how it feels right now. As a guy who's stared down impossible odds overseas, I can sense when fellow patriots get that mix of complacency and doubt creeping in. Minnesota hasn't sent a Republican to the U.S. Senate since 2002. We haven't voted Republican for president since 1976. The polls say it's a long shot, but the Democrats have deep pockets and a messy, well-funded primary between Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan and Rep. Angie Craig. It's easy to think:

_**"Why pour money into this when the deck's stacked?"**_

But Fellow Conservative, that's exactly when the left wins – when good people like you sit on the sidelines, figuring someone else will carry the load. With Tina Smith retiring, this seat is truly open for the first time in a generation. No incumbent shield. A volatile national environment. And on our side, I'm stepping up as a former Navy SEAL and Marine veteran – not a polished politician, but a regular Minnesotan from a working-class family who enlisted right after 9/11 at 18, deployed nine times to over 70 countries, and never backed down when the fight got hard.

Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the Guard before his unit deployed for Iraq, I answered the call and kept serving through the toughest missions. _**I've got the credentials to match the grit: A master's from Harvard, a Johns Hopkins certification in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA.**_ But what drives me most is making my mom proud – and now, making Minnesota proud again by fighting for the values we grew up with: law and order, lower taxes for families and retirees, secure borders, Second Amendment rights, and stopping the radical agenda that's defunded police, let our streets burn in 2020, and crushed us with inflation.

But what drives me most is making my mom proud – and now, making Minnesota proud again by fighting for the values we grew up with: law and order, lower taxes for families and retirees, secure borders, Second Amendment rights, and stopping the radical agenda that's defunded police, let our streets burn in 2020, and crushed us with inflation. And if we don't act, it gets worse – nationally, with another Democrat vote to block real border security, raise taxes, and erode freedoms. Just like I told folks early on: this ends one of two ways. Either you help elect a combat-tested SEAL to the Senate, or you read this and know who I am... but the regret of not acting lingers. Think about 2008: that Senate race came down to 312 votes after a 47-day recount. Every dollar mattered then. It will now. – funds the ads to build name ID, the ground game to turn out conservatives in the suburbs and Iron Range, and the fight to get through our primary (where I'm up against other Republicans but focused on uniting the party around proven values). Fellow Conservative, I've faced worse odds in places most people can't imagine. I thrive in tough fights. But I can't do this alone. Imagine looking back after November 2026, knowing you could have helped flip this seat, secure our Senate majority, and send a warrior to Washington – but complacency won instead. Don't let that happen. Get excited with me. Step up today. Any amount makes a difference. Thank you for considering this – and for everything you've already done for our country. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

This week in **West Bloomfield, Michigan** , a man rammed a vehicle into **Temple Israel synagogue** while more than one hundred children and staff were inside the building.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=190956824&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkwOTU2ODI0LCJpYXQiOjE3NzM1MTgzMDAsImV4cCI6MTc3NjExMDMwMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.9OeSeO7z1DK3Dn-aaiPIsnZmeRN0zP1LGWtavl41ck8)
[Pledge your support](https://substack..eXFe_sTx5PjJkU-4PjRnMBxAJ3lhh9B_4b3LB4p0qbo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=190956824)
The vehicle reportedly contained gasoline and fireworks intended to ignite a massive explosion.
Then the attacker opened fire.
What stopped the massacre was not a federal safety program touted by our politicians, especially those in Connecticut.
It was **a security guard -- a former police officer -- who immediately engaged the attacker and stopped him before he could reach the children inside**.
Officials later said the outcome **could have resembled Sandy Hook** if that guard had not acted.
Let that sink in.
A synagogue full of 140 children was seconds away from becoming the next national tragedy.
And the only thing standing between those children and mass murder were security guards and **one prepared man willing to act**.
## Washington's Response? Paperwork.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cbb88d2c-b86e-40e0-9c99-cf2307eb693c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Congress has spent years discussing programs and legislation to answer the calls to stop antisemitism:
• Nonprofit Security Grant Program
• Pray Safe Act
• WORSHIP Act
• Antisemitism Response Act
But here is the reality.
In **2024 alone** , more than **7,500 synagogues, churches, and religious institutions applied for nearly $1 billion in security funding**.
Most were denied.
That means thousands of houses of worship in America are now told:
**Protect yourselves.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/71c5c651-95aa-44c2-8a77-9ff7b00f7b62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
At least this Synagogue was prepared -
When demand for protection exceeds the government's willingness to provide it, something deeper is broken.
What Washington offers is often **bureaucracy instead of courage** and definitions instead of solutions.
It feels increasingly like **putting a band-aid on a bullet hole**.
## Jews Know Where Their Real Allies Are
Something else is becoming increasingly clear.
Many conservative, pro-Israel Jews in America are realizing that their strongest allies are **not the political institutions that claim to protect them**.
Their strongest allies are often **Christian Americans**.
* Christian pastors.
* Christian lawmakers.
* Christian voters.

Throughout history, when Jews were threatened, the difference between safety and danger often came down to **whether righteous people stood up in time**.
Today, the Jewish community is once again looking for **those righteous allies**. Are you one of those and are you willing to fight?
For the Jews of Connecticut in the wake of October 7th, the concern of Jim Himes was about Islamophobia (which is not uncommon for the representatives of Connecticut):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6489e61d-912b-49de-a332-e6e7d663f3d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
