## Christians: This Is Your Wake-Up Call
There are **tens of millions of Christians in the United States** who believe in faith, freedom, and the Bible.
If even a fraction of those believers became politically engaged, **the direction of this country would change overnight**.
Former Arkansas State Senator **Jason Rapert** and President of the[ National Association of Christian Lawmakers ](https://substack.com/redirect/23ed3564-00f4-4cbf-919e-dfaffd2001c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)has said it clearly:
* Christians already have the numbers.
* What they often lack is the willingness to **use their political power to defend their values**.
* Because make no mistake: The forces attacking synagogues today **will not stop there**.
* History has never worked that way.
* The same ideologies that target Jews will eventually target **Christians, churches, and biblical faith itself**.

_**It is time for the Christians to get politically active and support campaigns, especially those who are fighting to preserve and defend the constitution, the Judeo-Christian foundation of our nation, stand up against antisemitism, and stand by Israel and our allies.**_
The fundamental terrors of hate always come for the Jews on Saturday and then come for the Christians on Sunday
## America Made a Promise
In 1790, President **George Washington wrote to the Jewish community of Newport, Rhode Island**.
He promised them something radical for its time:
> "May the Children of the Stock of Abraham... sit in safety under their vine and fig tree, and there shall be none to make them afraid."
That promise defined America.
Today it is being tested and not just against American Jews but American Christians as radical groups take over America from Manhattan to Michigan. Your Fight Matters.
## Why This Election Matters for Connecticut's 4th District?
This is exactly why **[Dr. Michael Goldstein is running for Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/b7df5518-2192-474e-8694-df12a6868fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
He believes America must return to the principles that made this nation strong:
* Faith.
* Courage.
* Moral clarity.
* And the defense of religious freedom.

The future will require **a greater alliance between Jews and Christians who understand that our freedoms stand or fall together**.
## Christians: Invest in the Leaders Who Will Fight
If you believe in:
**• defending Israel
• protecting religious freedom
• preserving the Judeo-Christian foundations of America**
Then this moment requires more than prayer.
It requires action.
It requires engagement.
It requires supporting leaders who are willing to confront the real threats facing this country.
Because civilizations do not collapse in a single day.
They decline slowly -- when good people assume someone else will defend them.
As it says in the book of James - **Faith Without Works Is Dead**
## The Time to Wake Up Is Now
The synagogue in Michigan was saved because **one man refused to look away**.
America will be saved the same way.
If millions of faithful Americans decide that **defending faith and freedom is their responsibility**.
Christians:
This is your moment.
Support leaders who will defend the alliance between **Jews, Christians, and the freedoms that built this nation**.
A new generation of leadership is emerging.
And it needs your support.

body:
In most other states, campaigns can afford a mistake or two

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127337539/607722426/1751931448?amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&refcode=email_031426_pa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NGVmYmMwNS1kZjFmLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ouJFiVKkFcNNzRqIZeTkW-zg5Qiv8V8SIT2jEzQCtW4=) Let’s be honest, Derek: In most other states, campaigns can afford a mistake or two. In a deep blue state, a slow fundraising month isn’t the end of the world — and it almost certainly won’t decide the outcome of an election. But here in Pennsylvania? One slow fundraising month could be the difference between a Governor who protects our fundamental rights — or one who dismantles them. _**by Cliff Schecter**_
Only the MAGA movement--which has gifted us Jewish space lasers, a puppy shooter, and George Santos, Anthony Devolder, Anthony Zabovsky, and Kitara Revache, all one person--could come up with someone as ridiculous as MarkWayne Mullin.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0867c1c5-f425-4e47-ac74-6d214e6f6e8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And only in our culturally degraded, learnin's-hard land of the free could this creature be handed the responsibility of protecting the lives of 342,378,397 Americans.
* * *
### **MMA Moron = DHS Doofus**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8d212b6-9227-4cdd-9491-ba1f12f10979?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Mullin, currently a U.S. Senator from Oklahoma, former plumbing business owner and never-ending mouth, is more WWE heel than representative of the people. And, more generally, a MAGA-standard, extra-y-chromosome, science-denying asshole.
You know that cousin or brother-in-law who's always showing up at family the BBQ to tell _everyone_ how they're doing _everything wrong_ --when he/she hasn't had a steady job since _Titanic_ came out, has done two stints upstate for grand-theft auto, and recently kicked a sixteen-year heroine habit?
Yeah, that's Mullin.
So with Donald Trump being who _he_ is and and this dingaling being who _he_ is--Trump, of course, had to name him his next nominee to be Director of Homeland Security.
_[This is where in the horror movie a young, female character screams "we're all gonna die!"]_
The _had to_ in that equation is some combination of Trump's increasing dementia and the dimwitted, substance-free fraud he's always been. Trump's like the Jim Carrey character in _The Cable Guy_. Television, and especially reality tv, rules his world. It's why he's always obsessed with ratings, what comedians say about him, etc.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fc352866-b16a-49ca-af0b-da3b1e29235d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Another part of this is his determining if someone "looks the part."
So in Mullin's case, it has nothing to do with what he knows--which is roughly on par with what intellectually drives a fevered mongoose. It's all attitude. To Trump, that is the qualification.
Mullin struts around with a puffed out chest and planet-sized chip on his shoulder. It's his _fake tough guy_ routine. He--technically--was a "professional MMA fighter," meaning even his Senate bio which brags about this feels like it's being self-conscious, as it admits he only participated _in five fights_.
If that's all it takes to go pro at something, I'm bound for the kitty-litter cleansing Hall of Fame.
But Mullin did go 5-0 in those fights, _you say,_ upon gazing at his bio. _Except, he didn 't_. The official MMA record says _he only had three fights_. Two against the same guy. He spent less than 10 minutes in an MMA ring in his life. In total.
So**why** would somebody lie, making up two extra fights and pretending they did something professionally for longer than it takes me to stretch in the morning? Because that's the level of self-loathing and low-rent narcissism that comes with being MAGA--including this dipstick.
And a solid metaphor for MarkWayne's life.
Scratch the surface, and you find yourself rapidly sinking into a quicksand of scandal, gin-soaked intellectual pablum, and "Me Mongo" masculinity distilled into perfect stereotype. But let's roll it back for a second.
Trump nominated Mullin recently after Kristi Noem's was beclowned during committee hearings--or got "Lewandowski-d" you might say--by numerous Democrats. Trump decided he needed a more serious, sober candidate.
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5b78ef67-6ccc-4ccd-96a8-40b4b41518a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I'm just messin' with you, it's frickin Trump! He needed a guy not who is tough, but _seems that way_.
He had to appoint a UN Secretary in 2017, so he was like "Nikki's Indian, she's gotta get all the shit-hole countries crap," and she became Secretary. He took one look at Ben Carson, and was like "Housing & Urban Development!" Well, that very same rodent-sized, leaking frigate--Trump's cerebrum--sized up Mullin the know-nothing Road House extra and was like "he's big, he likes to fight and spent more time in a ring than he does bathing monthly. **Perfect** to protect our vast and complex nation from terrorists!"
(Presumably not his ~~personal terrorists~~ freedom fighters, should they pay a return visit to DC on another cold January 6th).
* * *
### **MACHO MACHO MAGA MAN**
Sure, Senator Two-Names' most significant act in the world greatest deliberative body was challenging the Head of the Teamsters _to take it outside_ ...**the Capitol** ("Stand your butt up"), as he questioned him during a hearing on organized labor. In one of the most surreal moments in modern congressional history, Mullin literally challenged Teamsters president Sean O'Brien to take a disagreement outside and fight during a Senate hearing.
Not debate. Not argue policy. Fight. On the lawn.

Fellow Conservative,

A recent headline captured it perfectly: “Republicans Face a Tough Fight to Defend the Senate Majority in 2026.”

Here’s the reality I see every day: If we lose the Senate, our opponents will push their agenda forward without effective checks — and that would hurt Montana families, our borders, our energy security, and so much more.

**As a Navy SEAL who served overseas to protect this country, and now as your Senator fighting for Montana in Washington, I’m committed to doing everything I can to prevent that outcome. **

That’s why I’m personally reaching out today with an opportunity to make your support go further.

I’m asking you to consider a split contribution across three critical Senate campaigns that will help determine control of the chamber in 2026. Your gift will be divided equally among them through a secure, efficient platform — **[multiplying your impact without extra effort. [Secure Link]](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=6f5069e7b9244e1db4ff1b3340d92cfd&_e=mv23f_ln2WOJTfGnT2B14EU6GYhcQ_TeptK9sdmUiS_2NaT6W_uj8O-uamrFQDyAVnl7ZG7lfrObxn6NL0ngAWrS3ITfinXZ5LM5nNnmhSUGs0azVML2IG0IxaqzGj4_u4KHpLhpcCAvISiC2S7bldpzQAf2CwZl2_53rd6aAa0ego5kABiehiBX8BZp6fJLDwFH98IE-q-TKNrEQTKpQFmF-8wGTPKJhBg5YkrfdBdcW7Ca-C0E7tM5v5Ikdw9FcjDOa_CGoaRKk2ZYFG8UhTtjzy7a0OvKSEsiLWK_t9GvVk12_Hy4WQBkeYXxHaWOSzrFSh9u7-dZztOQ1Vo09nFVaxXrhQ64z4A9XhmvI68qsbac_oPNg7HSoXoDT1neAaMfxfNH4wyYxwlDOmKGcqBcp-z9o4kzfa-14TDUZflnCmv8969IJGYZ8MWIglo8A-mzt7R_1Cs-vmk4XwjHgnF3pGJ5v30OmXiJvdrjTw5mg6ypOodyzzyHwTHif1m_czkTBKVa17qVbSkqyxoXt5aDKlsaaPxTu34mqpRSHc0kaYBrZ_-xCbywIP4d-DFHeNo7zIaVeGFxxg1j7RW-pgl9m3kluNb2wawZlGMtxN7TMY0DWcuUT6GNqarz7uJWbC23iPmZBu_qByUPrjksU465kABc_8bruFzcZ5NaiQ9RVma6F78FyzydPfQazCjTt-zGYy78NDR0GxiQ7Wu9lU5P1anlGF9hPtEQ5Db4Jlk%3D) **

Here are the three strong Republicans on the front lines:
* **Ashley Moody in Florida:** former Attorney General, appointed to the Senate by Gov. DeSantis after Marco Rubio became the Secretary of State. She’s proven she can take on tough fights in court and win for conservative principles. Democrats are targeting this seat hard — we can’t let them flip it.

* **Michael Whatley in North Carolina:** As former RNC Chairman, he helped secure major victories in 2024. Now he’s running for an open seat that Democrats view as their top target. Winning here keeps momentum on our side.

TO: Chief Justice John Roberts
FROM: A Proud Democrat
SUBJECT: Protect the Voting Rights Act
_Chief Justice John Roberts,_

I know Donald Trump and Mike Johnson are pressuring you to destroy The Voting Rights Act.

**But at a time when our democracy is already under unprecedented threat,_this would be a disaster_ for the American public.**

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

# **LA parents sue school district, claiming "secrecy policy" on son's gender identity contributed to his suicide**
Dylan Parke's parents, Kathleen Mulligan and Andrew Parke, **[filed a California federal court lawsuit against the Los Angeles Unified School District](https://substack.com/redirect/d0737e07-c223-4b04-91ac-046bbc6bb77c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , alleging Palisades Charter High School's "secrecy policy" kept them in the dark about their son's gender transition in 2019-2020, helped "sever" their relationship, and "ultimately resulted in Dylan's suicide" in March 2024 at age 19.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d0737e07-c223-4b04-91ac-046bbc6bb77c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **How it started:** Dylan, who struggled with depression and was in mental health treatment, told school staffers he would use she/her pronouns and go by "Aria" as a sophomore.

* **Why it matters:** Despite Mulligan emailing in August 2020 expressing concerns that Dylan was "easily influenced," possibly on the autism spectrum, and reeling from being cut from the baseball team -- assuring staff she was "not transphobic" but worried about "social contagion related to gender identity" -- educators did not respond and "denied them the opportunity to participate in the care of their minor son." Staff "affirmed and reinforced" Dylan's transition "enthusiastically and with praise and support" while giving him information on LGBTQ youth housing, listing him as "Aria Parke" in the June 2022 graduation program.
* **The legal context:** Attorney Aaron Siri noted the irony that "in schools, parents must give permission for nearly everything, including receiving medicine, school trips ... yet the secrecy policy at issue excluded parents from the incredibly consequential decision to transition their child." California passed AB 1955 in 2024 barring schools from revealing a child's gender identity without permission, but the law was struck down in December by a federal judge. LAUSD Superintendent Alberto Carvalho, named in the suit, is reportedly being investigated by the FBI for fraud and was placed on paid administrative leave after a Feb. 25 raid on his home.

* * *
# **Iran holding world 's energy supply "hostage" with "World War I-style" sea mine tactics in Strait of Hormuz**
Former CENTCOM Communications Director Col. Joe Buccino (Ret.) **[said Iran is using thousands of stockpiled sea mines to halt shipping](https://substack.com/redirect/74fb4117-ec35-4a67-8004-fb15de4cf30f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** through the Strait of Hormuz, a vital artery for global oil, calling it "a nightmare more than 30 years in the making" and "World War I-style combat." The mines create "psychological warfare" by generating fear and uncertainty about their location and number, effectively shutting down flow through the strait and sending oil prices surging.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/74fb4117-ec35-4a67-8004-fb15de4cf30f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Buccino warned the mines are becoming a serious issue because the U.S. Navy has "decommissioned" most of its ships with mine-clearing capabilities, and Iran is "exploiting a gap" in U.S. naval assets. The mines can detonate on or below the water's surface with explosions that would likely "tear a hole through a ship's hull, potentially sinking or disabling it." President Trump said Friday the U.S. would be willing to escort vessels through the strait "if we needed to."
* **The escalation:** Trump announced Friday the U.S. struck military locations on Kharg Island, Tehran's oil infrastructure hub in the Persian Gulf, calling it "one of the most powerful bombing raids in the history of the Middle East" that "totally obliterated every MILITARY target." While the U.S. purposefully avoided targeting oil infrastructure, Trump warned that could change if Iran continues disrupting shipping. Iran's new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei vowed Thursday the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the war ends and demanded U.S. military bases be removed from the region.

# **Ric Grenell stepping down as Trump-Kennedy Center CEO amid renovations, artist boycotts**
Former acting Director of National Intelligence Ric Grenell **[is reportedly stepping down from his role as CEO and executive director of the Trump-Kennedy Center,](https://substack.com/redirect/d85a3e90-7f94-452e-991f-313a5cbe4acd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Matt Floca, the current vice president of facilities operations, set to replace him subject to board approval. President Trump thanked Grenell for his "excellent job" coordinating the center during the transition period as the venue prepares to close for two years of extensive renovations beginning after July 4.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d85a3e90-7f94-452e-991f-313a5cbe4acd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Grenell's departure, first reported by Axios, comes as the center has faced backlash after Trump overhauled the board, took over as chair, and changed the lineup--including ending drag shows for children. The board voted in December to rename it "The Donald J. Trump and The John F. Kennedy Memorial Center for the Performing Arts," causing "mass uproar from leftists." Artists have canceled shows before and after the name change, including composer Philip Glass who canceled his June symphony premiere, saying the leadership conflicted with the work's Lincoln-themed message.
* **The pushback:** Center spokeswoman Roma Daravi defended the changes, saying "we have no place for politics in the arts, and those calling for boycotts based on politics are making the wrong decision," adding "we have not canceled a single show. Leftist activists are pushing artists to cancel but the public wants artists to perform and create." The center is seeking $1 million in damages from jazz musician Chuck Redd for canceling his Christmas Eve performance days before it was scheduled. Trump was clear about changes when he became chairman, writing "NO MORE DRAG SHOWS, OR OTHER ANTI-AMERICAN PROPAGANDA."

LA parents sue school district, claiming "secrecy policy" on son's gender identity contributed to his suicide Dylan Parke's parents, Kathleen Mulligan and Andrew Parke, , alleging Palisades Charter High School's "secrecy policy" kept them in the dark about their son's gender transition in 2019-2020, helped "sever" their relationship, and "ultimately resulted in Dylan's suicide" in March 2024 at age 19. | | ---|---|--- How it started: Dylan, who struggled with depression and was in mental health treatment, told school staffers he would use she/her pronouns and go by "Aria" as a sophomore. Why it matters: Despite Mulligan emailing in August 2020 expressing concerns that Dylan was "easily influenced," possibly on the autism spectrum, and reeling from being cut from the baseball team -- assuring staff she was "not transphobic" but worried about "social contagion related to gender identity" -- educators did not respond and "denied them the opportunity to participate in the care of their minor son." Staff "affirmed and reinforced" Dylan's transition "enthusiastically and with praise and support" while giving him information on LGBTQ youth housing, listing him as "Aria Parke" in the June 2022 graduation program. The legal context: Attorney Aaron Siri noted the irony that "in schools, parents must give permission for nearly everything, including receiving medicine, school trips ... yet the secrecy policy at issue excluded parents from the incredibly consequential decision to transition their child." California passed AB 1955 in 2024 barring schools from revealing a child's gender identity without permission, but the law was struck down in December by a federal judge. The board voted in December to rename it "The Donald J. Trump and The John F. Kennedy Memorial Center for the Performing Arts," causing "mass uproar from leftists." | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Peter,
I went on CNN to talk about something that should concern every American. Watch my interview here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2603-q1-jg-cnn?refcode=260314-email]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2603-q1-jg-cnn?refcode=260314-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2603-q1-jg-cnn?refcode=260314-email]
The Department of Justice under Donald Trump is now suing nearly 30 states for sensitive voter records that they do not have the legal right to access.
When they demanded Colorado hand over our voter information, including sensitive personal data, I had a simple response:
Take a hike.
Colorado will not help Donald Trump undermine our elections or put voters’ personal information at risk.
For years, extremists have spread lies about our elections to try to justify attacks on voting rights. Now they’re trying a new tactic: using the power of the federal government to scoop up voter data across the country.
It’s wrong. It’s dangerous. And I will keep fighting it.
That’s why I spoke out on CNN and why I’ve been standing up to federal overreach and election misinformation my entire time as Secretary of State.
But the truth is, standing up to powerful forces like this takes resources — and it takes people willing to fight back.
As your next Attorney General, I’ll continue defending our democracy, protecting voters, and enforcing the law no matter who tries to intimidate us. If you’re with me in this fight, please consider chipping in today to support our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2603-q1-jg-cnn?refcode=260314-email]
Thank you for standing up for our democracy.
Jena Griswold

name: Marsha Blackburn
subject: This comes from the heart.
body:
I’m so proud to be in this with you.

| | | | Peter,
They call us “radicals.”
They call us “extremists.”
They call us “deplorables.”
The media mocks us. The Hollywood elites look down on us. The D.C. swamp tries to break us every single day.
But when I look at you, Peter, I don’t see any of that,

I see a patriot.
I see a hero who works hard, loves their family, and stands up for what is right, even when it’s not popular.
I see someone with a spine of steel who loves this country too much to let it go. I don't say this enough, but I am so incredibly proud to be in this fight with you.
I wanted to send you this personal message as a small token of my appreciation. Something to remind you that you are seen, you are valued, and you are vital to saving America. | [ ACCEPT MY THANKS >> ](https://trk.emails.marshablackburn.)
---
Thank you for being the best part of my job.

With gratitude,

Peter,

While the rise in popularity of politicians like Zohran Mamdani and his socialist policies might have come as a shock to many, I've been warning people about it for years.

Younger Americans do not know what socialism means.

When younger Americans think of "socialism," they think it means Sweden and Denmark.

They didn't grow up during the Cold War. They don't remember the Soviet Union. Or Stalin's Gulags or the Warsaw Pact. They couldn't even tell you what the initials U.S.S.R. stood for, or that Nazi is the abbreviation of National Socialist.

**Young Americans need to hear about socialism, real socialism, from someone who experienced it firsthand. I can think of no one better than Ayn Rand.**

Rand wrote novels like _We The Living_ , which dramatized the inhumanity of the Soviet system -- and most importantly, _Atlas Shrugged_ , which dramatized what would happen if socialism came to America. Rand's immense success in making the moral case for capitalism led my friend, the late Ed Crane, to call her "the greatest all-time recruiter for the liberty movement."

The challenge is that young people simply aren't reading novels anymore. In the 70s, 70% of young people read fiction daily for fun -- today, less than 12% do.

That's where The Atlas Society comes in. They bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for new audiences in innovative ways, including animated videos, viral social media, graphic novels -- even music videos. Plus online courses and live events.

I told Jennifer Grossman, The Atlas Society's CEO, that I would help her raise $30,000 online this month to introduce more young minds to Ayn Rand's ideas.

[If that’s all you need to hear, then please send an urgent donation of $10 or more to The Atlas Society to introduce the ideas of Ayn Rand to a new generation. First, Jennifer and I go back more than 35 years, when she was a White House Speechwriter, and Americans for Tax Reform was in its founding era. She's one of the most innovative, effective, and persevering executives I know. Over the past decade, she's built The Atlas Society into a juggernaut for freedom.

**The Atlas Society is the ONLY non-profit adapting Rand 's works into media that appeals to young Americans. **

Just one example: their animated book trailer for _Atlas Shrugged_ drew 12 million views, and DOUBLED sales of the novel! They're currently producing a full-length feature film of Anthem, Rand's dystopian novella.

I believe in their great work because I've seen the impact they've had.

It's why I've collaborated with The Atlas Society on various discussions and interviews, including speaking at their student conferences, doing interviews on their podcast, and even doing stand-up comedy at one of their fundraising galas!

clean_body: Peter, While the rise in popularity of politicians like Zohran Mamdani and his socialist policies might have come as a shock to many, I've been warning people about it for years. Younger Americans do not know what socialism means. When younger Americans think of "socialism," they think it means Sweden and Denmark. They didn't grow up during the Cold War. They don't remember the Soviet Union. Or Stalin's Gulags or the Warsaw Pact. They couldn't even tell you what the initials U.S.S.R. stood for, or that Nazi is the abbreviation of National Socialist. Young Americans need to hear about socialism, real socialism, from someone who experienced it firsthand. I can think of no one better than Ayn Rand. Rand wrote novels like We The Living , which dramatized the inhumanity of the Soviet system -- and most importantly, Atlas Shrugged , which dramatized what would happen if socialism came to America. Rand's immense success in making the moral case for capitalism led my friend, the late Ed Crane, to call her "the greatest all-time recruiter for the liberty movement." The challenge is that young people simply aren't reading novels anymore. In the 70s, 70% of young people read fiction daily for fun -- today, less than 12% do. That's where The Atlas Society comes in. They bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for new audiences in innovative ways, including animated videos, viral social media, graphic novels -- even music videos. Plus online courses and live events. I told Jennifer Grossman, The Atlas Society's CEO, that I would help her raise $30,000 online this month to introduce more young minds to Ayn Rand's ideas. Otherwise, please let me explain why I believe The Atlas Society and its leadership are best suited to combat the rise in popularity of these harmful ideologies. First, Jennifer and I go back more than 35 years, when she was a White House Speechwriter, and Americans for Tax Reform was in its founding era. She's one of the most innovative, effective, and persevering executives I know. Over the past decade, she's built The Atlas Society into a juggernaut for freedom. The Atlas Society is the ONLY non-profit adapting Rand 's works into media that appeals to young Americans. Just one example: their animated book trailer for Atlas Shrugged drew 12 million views, and DOUBLED sales of the novel! They're currently producing a full-length feature film of Anthem, Rand's dystopian novella. I believe in their great work because I've seen the impact they've had. It's why I've collaborated with The Atlas Society on various discussions and interviews, including speaking at their student conferences, doing interviews on their podcast, and even doing stand-up comedy at one of their fundraising galas! | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

body:
| Friend,

We always knew Jon Husted could be bought, but this is especially appalling. Take a look: [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/104567?t=6&akid=23048%2E878179%2E7y_T8R) Here are the facts: **New reports reveal that my opponent, Jon Husted, has taken 10x more money than any U.S. Senator from billionaire Leslie Wexner.****Wexner is a longtime associate of Jeffrey Epstein and one of his top co-conspirators.**

It gets worse. Husted didn’t just take Wexner’s money.

When the Senate had the chance to release the Epstein files and provide accountability for the victims, **Husted voted against it.**

Wexner’s most recent donation to Husted came _just two months before that vote._ You do the math.

It all makes me sick to my stomach.

Ohioans deserve transparency. We deserve accountability.

**We deserve a senator who fights for working people, not one who protects the rich and powerful. Not one who protects the Epstein class. Not one who protects pedophiles.**

I've spent my career holding powerful interests accountable – and I'm fighting as hard as I can to unseat Jon Husted and prove that working people, justice, and accountability matter more than protecting billionaires.

But no one person could win this fight alone. I need you, friend.

**If you believe the super wealthy shouldn’t get special treatment – and the truth shouldn’t be hidden –[I’m asking you to split $10 or whatever you can between my campaign and Voter Protection Project today to help us flip Ohio and bring accountability back to the Senate.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/104567?t=7&akid=23048%2E878179%2E7y_T8R)** If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Sherrod Brown and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/104568?t=8&akid=23048%2E878179%2E7y_T8R)

name: Rose For Congress
subject: Impeach.
body:
I am running for Congress in CA-02 and I believe in a government that answers to the people, not one that is an unrestrained paramilitary force.

| | | | | [|
---](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=f54c029199&e=8c53948e4c)
| | | | | |
# End the War. Impeach Trump.
---
| | Hi Friends,
I grew up in a police state. I’ve seen firsthand what happens when power is left unchecked and authoritarianism takes hold. Today, as Donald Trump escalates his dangerous war on Iran, and as threats of boots on the ground percolate, that history feels far too close to home.
I am running for Congress in CA-02 because I believe in a government that answers to the people, not one that functions as an unrestrained paramilitary force. To be clear: the people DO NOT want this war.
**If elected, I will vote to impeach Donald Trump for his reckless use of military force**. Accountability isn't just a political buzzword; it’s a necessity for our survival. We can’t allow a President to continue engaging in horrific, unrestrained military aggression that bypasses the will of the people. It’s a path that leads to ruin.
[**Rose doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs, lobbyists, AIPAC, or war profiteers. Will you chip in $26 today to help us take this fight to Washington?**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=89b3471081&e=8c53948e4c)
For too long, our leaders have chosen a "war economy" that prioritizes weapons over wellness and bombs over community investments. While the military-industrial complex thrives from war in Iran, families right here in Northern California are being squeezed by rising grocery bills and underfunded schools.
**It is time to transition to a Peace Economy.**
My plan is simple:
* End unconditional military aid to regimes committing human rights abuses and begin closing costly bases around the world.
* Replace endless war and threats of war with robust diplomacy.
* Redirect billions in war spending toward Medicare for All, affordable housing, clean energy, and a peace dividend to every American.

Every dollar we send to fuel destruction overseas is a dollar stolen from our own neighborhoods. We can afford to take care of our people—we just have to stop spending our future on the machinery of war.
This campaign belongs to you. It belongs to the families who want healthcare, the students who want a future, and the citizens who believe that no one, especially the President, is above the law.
[**Help us build a peace economy and restore accountability to the People’s House. Click here to make a contribution of any amount before our weekly deadline!**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=f2689222b5&e=8c53948e4c)
Onward for People, Peace and Planet,
Rose Penelope YeeCandidate for Congress, CA-02

Hey there, Peter! It’s Rob Sand, the Democrat running for governor in the great state of Iowa.
It’s clear: Iowa has been trending in the wrong direction for the better part of the last decade — you know it, I know it, and the numbers folks at _Morning Consult_ know it:
**_Morning Consult:_** **_With the highest disapproval ratings of any U.S. governor (49%), Kim Reynolds of Iowa remains America’s most unpopular governor for the eighth quarter in a row_**

Ouch, Peter. Incumbent Republican Governor Kim Reynolds is the least popular governor in the country for 8 quarters running... 😬
But if I’m being honest, it’s not surprising — because I’ve spent darn-near every waking moment talking to Iowans about how we can move our state forward.
_Iowans are also smart enough to know that the partisan insiders seeking to replace her would mean more of the same: more jobs leaving the state, more high prices, and more policies that leave a majority of Iowans behind._
And let me tell you, folks are ready for a hard reset on the way we’ve been doing politics.
_Enter, yours truly._
Between polling showing me with a narrow, 2-pt lead and multiple outlets calling this race a toss-up, it’s clear our campaign has all the MOMENTUM in this must-win race.
I’ve got a plan to shift gears away from partisan rhetoric and to instead focus on affordability, education, and making our state a place where folks want to raise a family, or start a business.
